propositions: Operators need read-only diagnostic visibility into lock holder identity, liveness, hold duration, and staleness to unblock wedged stores when locks are held or orphaned

rebar doctor must report four lock legs (tickets-write fcntl, tickets-write mkdir, hlc fcntl, enrich-drain O_EXCL) with state (held/free/absent), ownership stamp fields (host/ns/pid/start), and holder liveness only for same-host pids

A stale lock (as determined solely by lock_owner._mkdir_lock_is_stale with inherited pid-recycle and wall-clock ceiling rules) must produce a lock finding and force exit code 1; a held lock with a live holder must produce INFO only and exit 0
rebar doctor --repair must never mutate, delete, or reclaim any lock state (lock dir, owner file, drain lock file remain unchanged; repair loop excludes lock findings)
The lock section must be reported in both text and JSON output, validated against an updated doctor.schema.json, and documented in docs/cli-reference.md
